Introduzione
Per rafforzare le nostre vendite all'interno del servizio in Volketswil/ZH stiamo cercando un n comunicativo e indipendente

Servizio di vendita personale/in-house, 100%

ITS TASK

• Responsabile per la lavorazione degli ordini fluidi ed efficienti

• Registrazione degli ordini del cliente e trattamento tempestivo

• Mantenere la base del cliente

• Registrazione degli ordini del fornitore e disposizione del materiale

• Trattamento delle preoccupazioni e delle preoccupazioni dei clienti del servizio esterno

• Trattamento dei reclami

• Partecipazione ai processi di miglioramento

• Elaborazione dei rendimenti incl. Preparazione dei crediti

• Elaborazione delle bollette dei creditori nel programma Medius

• Responsabilità per la ricezione presso il sito Volketswil

• Ordinazione e gestione di uffici e materiali di consumo

• Coordinamento aggiunto della nostra accademia weber (Centro di formazione)

Il tuo progetto

• Hai completato la formazione commerciale o tecnica con la formazione commerciale

• Il pensiero e l'azione orientati al cliente e alla soluzione sono una questione ovviamente per voi

• Sei una personalità decisionale e ti piace assumerti la responsabilità

• A loro piace lavorare in una squadra e mantenere la calma sotto stress elevato

• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura, così come una buona conoscenza del francese

• Hai una buona conoscenza del pacchetto MS-Office e SAP

• La comprensione del processo e il pensiero in rete sono tra i vostri punti di forza

Le tue prospettive

• Versatile area di responsabilità in un'azienda internazionale ma a conduzione familiare

• Una cultura aziendale con spazio per responsabilità personale e idee imprenditoriali

• Un ambiente in cui l'apertura e l'apprezzamento sono ovviamente una questione

• Condizioni di lavoro attraenti con prestazioni sociali superiori alla media

• Supporto per il tuo sviluppo personale

"Fare il mondo una casa migliore" - questo è il nostro scopo.
Con il nostro ampio portafoglio di marchi, sviluppiamo, produciamo e distribuiamo materiali e soluzioni per il settore delle costruzioni e per i vari mercati industriali in un continuo processo di innovazione.
Come produttore leader mondiale di materiali da costruzione per buste da costruzione di alta qualità, prodotti speciali e sistemi per l'edilizia e l'ingegneria civile, soluzioni per la posa di piatti e innovative costruzioni da terra e da parete, Saint-Gobain Weber AG si impegna per le persone nel loro ambiente di costruzione e di vita.
Siamo una filiale del gruppo globale francese Saint-Gobain. Il Gruppo si impegna a edifici confortevoli, efficienti e vivibili. In Svizzera, Saint-Gobain è rappresentata a fianco di Weber con aziende come Rigips, ISOVER, Sanitas Troesch o Vetrotech.
Date un'occhiata al nostro sito www.ch.weber.

Per domande, Florentina Ukaj, HRBP, è disponibile su +41 76 203 50 13.

Introduction
To strengthen our sales inside service in Volketswil/ZH we are looking for a communicative and independent n

Personnel/in-house sales service, 100%

ITS TASKS

• Responsible for smooth and efficient order processing

• Recording of customer orders and ensuring timely processing

• Maintaining the customer base

• Recording of supplier orders and disposition of the material

• Processing of customer concerns and concerns of the external service

• Processing of complaints

• Participation in improvement processes

• Processing of returns incl. Preparation of credits

• Processing of creditors' bills in the Medius program

• Responsibility for reception at the Volketswil site

• Ordering and managing office and consumables

• Deputy coordination of our weber academy (Training Center)

YOUR PROFILE

• You have completed commercial or technical training with commercial training

• Customer- and solution-oriented thinking and action is a matter of course for you

• You are a decision-making personality and like to take on responsibility

• They like to work in a team and keep calm under high stress

• You have very good knowledge of German in words and writing as well as good knowledge of French

• You have good knowledge of the MS-Office package and SAP

• Process understanding and networked thinking are among your strengths

YOUR PERSPECTIVES

• Versatile area of responsibility in an international and yet family-run company

• A corporate culture with space for personal responsibility and entrepreneurial ideas

• An environment in which openness and appreciation are a matter of course

• Attractive employment conditions with above-average social benefits

• Support for your personal development

"MAKING THE WORLD A BETTER HOME" - that's our purpose.
With our broad brand portfolio, we develop, produce and distribute materials and solutions for the construction sector and various industrial markets in a continuous innovation process.
As the world's leading manufacturer of building materials for high-quality building envelopes, special products and systems for building and civil engineering, plate laying solutions and innovative floor and wall constructions, Saint-Gobain Weber AG is committed to the people in their construction and living environment.
We are a subsidiary of the French global group Saint-Gobain. The Group is committed to comfortable, energy-efficient and liveable buildings. In Switzerland, Saint-Gobain is represented alongside Weber with companies such as Rigips, ISOVER, Sanitas Troesch or Vetrotech.
Take a look at our website www.ch.weber.

For questions, Florentina Ukaj, HRBP, is available on +41 76 203 50 13.

To strengthen our research and development team in Volketswil or Winterthur, we are looking for an independent and reliable personality as: Head of Product Safety 80 - 100% (preferably 80%) Responsible in this central position They cover all aspects of product safety - from the raw materials used to our manufactured products and instructions on the internal handling of chemicals. They report directly to the Director R&D and thus to the management. Their tasks
• Professional management and coordination of all topics related to the product safety of our products and raw materials
• Early identification and evaluation of regulatory trends and ensuring compliance with the resulting requirements
• Participation in sustainability and AI issues, in particular in the evaluation of raw materials and ensuring data quality
• Creation of documents (e.g. safety data sheets, labeling) and responsibility for their accuracy and timeliness
• Sparring partner for R&D and product management with important inputs on product compliance
• Contact person for authorities (e.g. FOPH), responsibility for processes and audits in this regard as well as monitoring and coordination of audits
• Coordination with central product safety offices of the Group and other internal offices (e.g. EHS)
• Planning and implementation of internal training and other training and information measures
• Participation in cross-divisional projects as well as in process optimization Your profile
• Completed studies in natural sciences, preferably chemistry (FH/Uni), or comparable training
• Several years of experience (> 5 years) in the field of product safety, ideally in the building materials environment
• Experience in dealing with standards, regulations and laboratory data
• Affinity to IT and interest in working with and developing AI solutions
• In-depth knowledge of REACH, CLP, GHS etc. as well as the ability to proactively advance these topics
• Knowledge of the European Construction Products Regulation is an advantage
• Good network with relevant stakeholders (authorities, environmental labels, professional associations, etc.)
• Safe handling of chemical compliance and SDS management systems (ChemGes desirable)
• Very good knowledge of German and English, French is advantageous
• Structured, precise and reliable working methods as well as a high sense of responsibility and initiative
• Flexibility, resilience and solution orientation Their perspectives
• Exciting tasks in a dynamic company
• Corporate culture with space for personal responsibility and entrepreneurial ideas
• A working environment in which openness and appreciation are a matter of course
• Attractive employment conditions with above-average social benefits
• Individual introductory programme adapted to the functional requirements
• Support for your individual professional development "MAKING THE WORLD A BETTER HOME" - that's our purpose. With our broad brand portfolio, we develop, produce and distribute materials and solutions for the construction sector and various industrial markets in a continuous innovation process. As the world's leading manufacturer of building materials for high-quality building envelopes, special products and systems for building and civil engineering, plate laying solutions and innovative floor and wall constructions, Saint-Gobain Weber AG is committed to the people in their construction and living environment. We are a subsidiary of the French global group Saint-Gobain. The Group is committed to comfortable, energy-efficient and liveable buildings. In Switzerland, Saint-Gobain is represented alongside Weber with companies such as Rigips, ISOVER, Sanitas Troesch or Vetrotech. Take a look at our website www.ch.weber. If you have any questions, Florentina Ukaj, Head of HR, is available on +41 76 203 50 13. Saint Gobain
